answer:
The anime that features **Seta Sōjirō** is **"Rurouni Kenshin"** (also known internationally as **"Samurai X"**).

In the series, Sōjirō is a prominent antagonist who serves as the right-hand man to Shishio Makoto and is the fastest member of the infamous "Juppongatana" (Six-Swordsmen). He is often depicted as being highly skilled, emotionally detached due to brainwashing, and wielding a distinctive fan alongside two swords.
